meta.promptText: India mein acne wali skin ke liye 700 rupees ke andar konsa serum kharidun?

response.text:
Agar aapki skin **acne-prone** hai aur budget **₹700 ke andar** hai, to main sabse pehle **salicylic acid serum** ya **niacinamide serum** suggest karunga. **Active pimples/blackheads** ke liye salicylic acid better hota hai, aur **oil control + acne marks** ke liye niacinamide useful hota hai.[7][10][11]

**Best picks under ₹700 in India:**
- **Dot & Key Cica + 2% Salicylic Acid Serum for Acne** — around **₹467**; oily, acne-prone, sensitive skin ke liye listed hai.[7]
- **Deconstruct Salicylic Acid Face Serum** — around **₹599.25**; acne, blackheads, aur open pores ke liye positioned hai.[8]
- **The Derma Co 1% Salicylic Acid Serum** — around **₹526**; acne-fighting category me listed hai.[1]
- **Pilgrim 10% Niacinamide Face Serum** — around **₹649**; acne marks aur oil control ke liye useful hai.[5]
- **Simple 10% Niacinamide Booster Serum** — around **₹548**; budget-friendly niacinamide option hai.[15]
- **Lacto Calamine 2% Salicylic Acid Serum** — Amazon search results me ₹400 se neeche category me dikha hua acne/oil-control serum hai.[12]

**Mera simple recommendation:**
- Agar **abhi active pimples** hain: **Dot & Key Cica + 2% Salicylic Acid Serum** ya **Deconstruct Salicylic Acid Face Serum**.[7][8]
- Agar **pimples ke baad daag + oily skin** hai: **Pilgrim 10% Niacinamide** ya **Simple 10% Niacinamide**.[5][15]
- Agar aapko **single safe all-rounder** chahiye: **niacinamide** se start karna relatively easier hota hai, especially if skin sensitive ho.[5][15]

**Use ka short rule:**
- Salicylic acid serum ko usually **night** me use kiya jata hai, aur pehle **2–3 times/week** se start karna safer hota hai.
- Niacinamide ko usually **daily** tolerate kiya jata hai, but patch test karna useful hai.

Agar aap chaho, main aapke **skin type** ke hisaab se 3 exact options shortlist kar du: **oily**, **sensitive**, ya **acne marks wala**.
